subject: Request: Exec approval for 28% Hosted API rate break — Anthem Health (DEAL-8421)
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@anthem.ai>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API commercial ask — volume discount for pilot and ramp

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the technical fit looks good and the team is keen to run a 9-month pilot across three product lines. Procurement asked me to confirm whether Redwood can offer a deeper rate break for a committed consumption ladder. Rough numbers attached (consumption-forecast.csv).

High level ask: a 28% list-price discount on Hosted API usage for the first 12 months contingent on a 10M token minimum over the 9-month pilot, with an option to extend to a multi-year committed contract.

Can Redwood confirm whether this is feasible and what approvals you need from your side? We have a procurement window and would like to include any exec approvals on our side-plan this week.

Best,
Sara Klein
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Anthem Health

Attachments: consumption-forecast.csv (spreadsheet)
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API commercial ask — Anthem requests 28% rate break (requesting exec sign-off)

Team — forwarding Anthem's ask. Quick summary below and an attached MAA worksheet where I laid out the commitment ladder and expected unit economics. Key points:
- External asks for 28% off list for year 1 tied to a 10M token minimum during a 9-month pilot.
- Upside: large reference account in payer space, three product lines, clear path to multi-year committed ARR if pilot metrics hit.
- Risk: short-term unit economics negative unless we make concessions on batching/quantization guidance and require strict commitment terms + overage pricing.

What I need from you: Ben — would you put this into the deal desk queue and recommend whether this should route for a Senior Exec approval or CEO signoff? Marissa / Mina — need your quick read on margin impact and whether we can structure a partial credit/accelerator to protect Redwood if usage skews low.

I've attached: MAA_Anthem_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan & numbers), SOW-Anthem.pdf (draft SOW).

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0192

Attachments: MAA_Anthem_v1.xlsx, SOW-Anthem.pdf
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API commercial ask — Anthem requests 28% rate break (requesting exec sign-off)

Tessa — thanks for the concise summary and the MAA. I'm recommending we escalate this as a Senior Exec sanction (VP+), not CEO-only, given the strategic partner value and the committed minimum. Rationale:
- Deal profile: strategic payer, high expansion potential, acceptable legal/compliance posture (verified).
- Economic mitigations proposed: 60/40 revenue share on overage credits for year 1, required quarterly usage true-ups, and an early-termination claw that recovers credits pro rata if threshold missed.

Marissa — please confirm modeled gross margin under 28% list discount with the attached mitigations. Mina — please confirm whether finance can accept the proposed credit cadence (quarterly reconciliation + retention of 20% of credits until M4). If finance signs off, I'll move to get VP sanction in today's 4pm pricing committee.

Ben Carter
Head of Field Sales | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 17:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API commercial ask — Anthem requests 28% rate break (requesting exec sign-off)

Ben / Tessa — reviewed economics with Mina. This is painful on unit margin at a straight 28% list discount, but the mitigations (quarterly true-ups, deferred credit holdback, early-termination claw) make it tolerable if Anthem signs the 10M token minimum and we cap the first-90-day onboarding consumption at negotiated thresholds. Finance can live with the structure.

I will approve escalation to VP pricing committee for a one-time 28% sanction with the following non-negotiables to include in the VP memo and the commercial terms: 
- Binding 10M token minimum in Master Services Agreement (with DocuSign link in related links).
- Quarterly usage reconciliation and automatic overage billing at a blended rate (list less 10%) until true-up.
- Deferred credit schedule: 50% of credits withheld until M4 and released based on usage attainment.
- Legal to confirm SOW language on data isolation and SOC 2 scoping prior to DocuSign.

Ben — you have my go-ahead to present this to VP committee. Mina, please prepare a short finance note (2 slides) for VP packet. Tessa — please align Anthem on the guardrails and send them the revised MAA + SOW after VP sanction.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
Marissa.Cole@redwood.com
